title: Counting Words
summary: This book teaches children many ways to count things. Each page introduces number words and counting units to help kids understand numbers in everyday life.

postQuestions.question: What words do we use to count people or things?

missions.title: Counting My Favorite Things
missions.description: Find things with your family or friends and count them using different number words.

vocabulary.definition: A container for liquids, used for counting drinks.
A small cup for drinks, a way to count beverages.
A piece of flat food like pizza, used for counting.
A word to count people, especially kids.
Used to count paper or thin flat things.
A small bit of liquid, for counting drops.
